selection: each small head selected by validation normalized MSE; no test selection

frozen.context: pre_pi_actual contains current proprio; fixed_state uses normalized zero
frozen.cached_labels: world EE convention from cached left/right_endpose; not TCP
frozen.controlled_labels: world TCP and object origin; independent controlled snapshots
frozen.holdout: independent for readout fitting; cached episodes may have been seen by frozen parent

caveats: test independence applies to diagnostic head; parent saw some cached source episodes
static controlled images are a separate diagnostic distribution
poor small-readout results do not prove absence of information
cached world EE positions and controlled world TCP positions are separate targets
